# KI: 4-Stage Candidate Block Validation Filter & SQLite WAL Candidate Pool Storage

## Operational Summary
Evolving multi-agent team configurations must never be committed directly to production without structural gating. A 4-stage validation pipeline rigorously verifies that candidate agent blocks contain valid nodes, sound edge connections, zero circular dependency cycles, and meet performance baselines before committing into SQLite WAL candidate pools for dynamic $O(1)$ routing.
